name: Maison Delano Paris
insider_take: This contemporary palace hotel brings Miami's South Beach glamour to the heart of the 8th arrondissement, just steps from the Champs-Élysées.
whats_special: Maison Delano Paris occupies a stunning Haussmannian building from 1889, transformed by renowned designer Philippe Starck. The hotel features Alice in Wonderland-inspired interiors, a dramatic all-white lobby with towering ceilings, and the city's only rooftop with 360-degree views of Paris landmarks including the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe.
pro_tip: Book the Penthouse Suite for exclusive access to the private rooftop terrace - it's one of the most Instagrammable spots in Paris with unobstructed views of the entire city skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's Delano Café serves innovative French cuisine in a whimsical setting with oversized chess pieces and striped floors. The location puts you within a 3-minute walk of luxury shopping on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré and a 5-minute stroll to the iconic Galeries Lafayette.
pros: Sophisticated Delano design aesthetic with Parisian elegance
Stunning rooftop terrace with city views
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited room inventory
